title: Energy & Transformations
description: Types of energy, conservation of energy, and energy efficiency.

notes.heading: Types of Energy
notes.body: Kinetic (motion): KE=½mv². Gravitational potential (height): GPE=mgh. Elastic potential (stretched). Chemical (fuels, food). Thermal (heat). Nuclear, light, sound. Energy measured in joules (J).

notes.heading: Conservation of Energy
notes.body: Energy cannot be created or destroyed — only transferred or transformed. Total energy in a closed system stays constant. Example: falling ball converts GPE → KE. Light bulb: electrical → light + heat. Sankey diagrams show useful vs wasted energy.

notes.heading: Efficiency
notes.body: Efficiency = (useful output ÷ total input) × 100%. Nothing is 100% efficient — some energy always wasted as heat. Example: motor takes 500J, outputs 400J → efficiency = 80%. To improve: insulation, better design, reduced friction.
